Hi Vivek,

We're preparing a procurement packet for our platform team to increase observability retention and tracing coverage as part of a migration to Redwood. Before we move to PO, we need:

- A clear price schedule for retention (30/90/365 day buckets) and any step-pricing beyond a committed volume.
- Tracing retention/pricing (per-span or per-ingest) and whether sampling-based pricing is supported.
- Advanced dashboards: per-dashboard vs seat pricing, and whether saved-query costs are separate.
- Any onboarding/setup fees or professional services for dashboard migration.

We can commit to a 12-month term if the economics are right. Our expected profile (rough): 600 GB/month of retained telemetry, ~5M spans/day peak, ~12 power dashboards (+50 saved queries). Please do not include any early-negotiation NDAs in the quote; procurement just needs line-item costs and any volume discount thresholds.

Attached: SOW draft for scope (sow-acme-observability.docx). Can you provide a calibrated quote by EOD next Wednesday (2028-05-24)? Also include any credits for data migration month.

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Looping in Kim (pricing lead) and Grace (solutions) so we can give you a line-by-line and a commit path that matches procurement needs.

Quick high-level guidance so you have something to show stakeholders while we finalize numbers:
- Retention: we offer three recommended buckets (30d / 90d / 365d). Rough indicative pricing (non-binding): $0.045/GB-month (30d tier), $0.035/GB-month (90d tier), $0.022/GB-month (365d tier) with step discounts at commits of 500GB+, 2TB+.
- Tracing: two models — per-ingest span pricing (baseline) or sampled ingest (adaptive sampling) with effective cost reductions up to ~40% depending on sampling rules. Typical range: $0.000025 - $0.00006 per span depending on retention and rollup behavior.
- Advanced dashboards: baseline $150/dashboard/month or a seat-based $80/seat/month; saved-query compute is included up to a threshold and charged above that.

We will prepare a formal attachment with two commitment options (12- and 24-month) and a migration credit option for the first month if you sign by end of May. I attached a concise pricing overview for your internal review.

Next steps:
1) Kim to share the detailed sheet with tiered pricing and commit tradeoffs.
2) Grace to map your expected telemetry profile to recommended buckets and an estimated monthly spend.
3) Vivek to draft a final commercial term and DocuSign-ready quote.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales 
Redwood Inference
